segments.speaker: greg
segments.transcript:
"Fuck you."

I corrected it.

He was right.

Worse.

I built a small fire from the wood in my pack and dry material near the cave mouth.

The tinder refused.

Wind.

Damp.

Bad angle.

I tried again.

Ithar watched.

"No."

"I haven't asked."

segments.speaker: greg
segments.transcript:
"I was not."

The tinder smoked and died.

I looked at him.

One eye narrowed.

"Tiny fire."
